news: A persona can now greet guests, run a quiz and close the night with thanks.
Everything a club does can live in one memory that every member can search.
Mori the guide who never sleeps
A Bijou club built Mori to welcome newcomers. Mori has shown 30k members around.
Ask what is on tonight and it lists your events, rides and the looks you planned.

A memory that found a lost PFT
Asha asked where her old ticket went. The memory showed she lent it to a friend in July.
Share a workspace with your club and keep notes, files and chats together.
Remove a memory and everything made from it disappears too.
Sell or rent a persona to other clubs. You keep a royalty on each rental.
The assistant now drafts messages that read like you wrote them.
